title: RENEGADES: Brad Lomax: Creating Communities of Care
original_title: RENEGADES: Brad Lomax: Creating Communities of Care
overview: The story of a Black Panther Party member and founder of the East Oakland Center for Independent Living, who had multiple sclerosis and used a wheelchair. Explore Brad Lomax's under-reported contributions to the early disability justice movement, which laid the groundwork for the 1990 Americans with Disabilities Act.
